_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: courses
constraints: CHECK (term_start IS NULL OR term_end IS NULL OR term_start <= term_end)

data.name: tasks
constraints:
CHECK (
      (deadline_kind = 'none' AND deadline_date IS NULL AND deadline_utc IS NULL
        AND deadline_zone IS NULL AND deadline_boundary_utc IS NULL) OR
      (deadline_kind = 'dateOnly' AND deadline_date IS NOT NULL AND deadline_utc IS NULL
        AND deadline_zone IS NOT NULL AND deadline_boundary_utc IS NOT NULL) OR
      (deadline_kind = 'timed' AND deadline_date IS NULL AND deadline_utc IS NOT NULL
        AND deadline_zone IS NOT NULL AND deadline_boundary_utc IS NOT NULL
        AND deadline_boundary_utc = deadline_utc))

CHECK (target_utc IS NULL OR deadline_kind = 'none' OR
      (deadline_kind = 'dateOnly' AND target_utc < deadline_boundary_utc) OR
      (deadline_kind = 'timed' AND target_utc <= deadline_boundary_utc))

CHECK ((status = 'done' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL) OR
      (status != 'done' AND completed_at IS NULL))

data.name: activity_series
constraints: CHECK (start_date <= end_date)
CHECK ((recurrence = 'once' AND start_date = end_date AND weekdays = 0) OR (recurrence = 'weekly' AND weekdays BETWEEN 1 AND 127))
CHECK (end_minute + end_day_offset * 1440 > start_minute)

CHECK ((superseded_from IS NULL AND replaced_by IS NULL) OR (superseded_from IS NOT NULL AND replaced_by IS NOT NULL AND superseded_from >= start_date AND superseded_from <= end_date AND replaced_by != id))

data.name: activity_exceptions

elements: ("start_minute IS NULL OR (typeof(start_minute) = 'integer' AND start_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439)")
("end_minute IS NULL OR (typeof(end_minute) = 'integer' AND end_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439)")

constraints: CHECK ((moved_date IS NULL AND start_minute IS NULL AND end_minute IS NULL AND end_day_offset IS NULL AND zone IS NULL AND location IS NULL) OR (moved_date IS NOT NULL AND start_minute IS NOT NULL AND end_minute IS NOT NULL AND end_day_offset IS NOT NULL AND zone IS NOT NULL AND location IS NOT NULL))
CHECK (moved_date IS NULL OR end_minute + end_day_offset * 1440 > start_minute)

data.name: planned_work_blocks
constraints: CHECK (typeof(start_utc) = 'integer' AND typeof(end_utc) = 'integer' AND end_utc > start_utc)

data.name: focus_sessions
constraints: CHECK (typeof(planned_ms) = 'integer' AND ((kind='starter' AND planned_ms=120000) OR (kind='focus' AND planned_ms BETWEEN 60000 AND 10800000) OR (kind='rest' AND planned_ms BETWEEN 60000 AND 3600000)))

CHECK (typeof(elapsed_ms)='integer' AND typeof(eligible_ms)='integer' AND typeof(uncertain_ms)='integer' AND elapsed_ms BETWEEN 0 AND planned_ms AND eligible_ms>=0 AND uncertain_ms>=0 AND eligible_ms+uncertain_ms<=elapsed_ms)
CHECK ((kind='rest' AND eligible_ms=0) OR (kind!='rest' AND eligible_ms+uncertain_ms=elapsed_ms))
CHECK (subtask_id IS NULL OR task_id IS NOT NULL)
CHECK ((state IN ('running','paused') AND outcome IS NULL) OR (state IN ('awaitingReview','finalized') AND outcome IS NOT NULL))

CHECK ((state='finalized' AND reported_ms IS NOT NULL AND typeof(reported_ms)='integer' AND reported_ms BETWEEN 0 AND eligible_ms AND finalized_utc IS NOT NULL) OR (state!='finalized' AND reported_ms IS NULL AND finalized_utc IS NULL))

data.name: focus_segments
constraints: CHECK (typeof(span_ms)='integer' AND typeof(elapsed_ms)='integer' AND typeof(eligible_ms)='integer' AND span_ms>=0 AND elapsed_ms BETWEEN 0 AND span_ms AND eligible_ms BETWEEN 0 AND elapsed_ms)
CHECK (kind!='pause' OR (elapsed_ms=0 AND eligible_ms=0))
CHECK (reason IS NULL OR eligible_ms=0)

data.name: reminder_preferences_rows
constraints: CHECK (quiet_start != quiet_end)

data.name: reminder_rules
constraints: CHECK ((kind='deadline' AND task_id IS NOT NULL AND series_id IS NULL AND work_id IS NULL AND installation_id IS NULL) OR (kind='activity' AND task_id IS NULL AND series_id IS NOT NULL AND work_id IS NULL AND installation_id IS NULL) OR (kind='work' AND task_id IS NULL AND series_id IS NULL AND work_id IS NOT NULL AND installation_id IS NULL) OR (kind='timer' AND task_id IS NULL AND series_id IS NULL AND work_id IS NULL AND installation_id IS NOT NULL AND lead_minutes=0))

data.name: note_activity_pair
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX note_activity_pair ON note_activity_links (note_id, series_id, COALESCE(original_date, ''))

data.name: one_unfinished_session
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_unfinished_session ON focus_sessions (installation_id) WHERE state != 'finalized'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "focus_segments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(id) = 36 AND substr(id,9,1) = '-' AND substr(id,14,1) = '-' AND substr(id,19,1) = '-' AND substr(id,24,1) = '-' AND length(replace(id,'-','')) = 32 AND replace(id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(id,15,1) IN ('1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8') AND substr(id,20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b')), "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES focus_sessions (id), "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence >= 1), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('active','pause','gap')), "from_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "span_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "elapsed_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "eligible_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("session_id", "sequence"), CHECK (typeof(span_ms)='integer' AND typeof(elapsed_ms)='integer' AND typeof(eligible_ms)='integer' AND span_ms>=0 AND elapsed_ms BETWEEN 0 AND span_ms AND eligible_ms BETWEEN 0 AND elapsed_ms), CHECK (kind!='pause' OR (elapsed_ms=0 AND eligible_ms=0)), CHECK (reason IS NULL OR eligible_ms=0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "timer_command_receipts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(id) = 36 AND substr(id,9,1) = '-' AND substr(id,14,1) = '-' AND substr(id,19,1) = '-' AND substr(id,24,1) = '-' AND length(replace(id,'-','')) = 32 AND replace(id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(id,15,1) IN ('1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8') AND substr(id,20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b')), "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES focus_sessions (id), "action" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action IN ('start','pause','resume','extend','end','recover','finalize','background','foreground')), "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "committed_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminder_preferences_rows" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(id) = 36 AND substr(id,9,1) = '-' AND substr(id,14,1) = '-' AND substr(id,19,1) = '-' AND substr(id,24,1) = '-' AND length(replace(id,'-','')) = 32 AND replace(id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(id,15,1) IN ('1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8') AND substr(id,20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b')), "singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(singleton = 1) UNIQUE, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "quiet_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("quiet_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "quiet_start" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1320 CHECK(typeof(quiet_start)='integer' AND quiet_start BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "quiet_end" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 420 CHECK(typeof(quiet_end)='integer' AND quiet_end BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (quiet_start != quiet_end));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminder_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(id) = 36 AND substr(id,9,1) = '-' AND substr(id,14,1) = '-' AND substr(id,19,1) = '-' AND substr(id,24,1) = '-' AND length(replace(id,'-','')) = 32 AND replace(id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(id,15,1) IN ('1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8') AND substr(id,20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b')), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('deadline','activity','work','timer')), "task_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES tasks (id), "series_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES activity_series (id), "work_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES planned_work_blocks (id), "installation_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES installations (id), "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "lead_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(typeof(lead_minutes)='integer' AND lead_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND 10080), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((kind='deadline' AND task_id IS NOT NULL AND series_id IS NULL AND work_id IS NULL AND installation_id IS NULL) OR (kind='activity' AND task_id IS NULL AND series_id IS NOT NULL AND work_id IS NULL AND installation_id IS NULL) OR (kind='work' AND task_id IS NULL AND series_id IS NULL AND work_id IS NOT NULL AND installation_id IS NULL) OR (kind='timer' AND task_id IS NULL AND series_id IS NULL AND work_id IS NULL AND installation_id IS NOT NULL AND lead_minutes=0)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminder_registrations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(id) = 36 AND substr(id,9,1) = '-' AND substr(id,14,1) = '-' AND substr(id,19,1) = '-' AND substr(id,24,1) = '-' AND length(replace(id,'-','')) = 32 AND replace(id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(id,15,1) IN ('1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8') AND substr(id,20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b')), "rule_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reminder_rules (id), "identity_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "notification_id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(notification_id)='integer' AND notification_id BETWEEN 1000000 AND 2147483000) UNIQUE, "original_date" TEXT NULL CHECK(original_date IS NULL OR (length(original_date) = 10 AND original_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND substr(original_date,1,4) != '0000' AND date(original_date,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(original_date,'+0 days') = original_date)), "session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES focus_sessions (id), "source_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','scheduled','cancelled','elapsed','scheduleFailed','cancelFailed')), "error" TEXT NULL, "registered_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "opened_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weekly_reflections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(id) = 36 AND substr(id,9,1) = '-' AND substr(id,14,1) = '-' AND substr(id,19,1) = '-' AND substr(id,24,1) = '-' AND length(replace(id,'-','')) = 32 AND replace(id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(id,15,1) IN ('1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8') AND substr(id,20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b')), "week_start" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK((week_start IS NULL OR (length(week_start) = 10 AND week_start GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND substr(week_start,1,4) != '0000' AND date(week_start,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(week_start,'+0 days') = week_start)) AND strftime('%w',week_start) = '1') UNIQUE, "helped" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(helped) <= 5000), "obstacles" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(obstacles) <= 5000), "adjustment" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(adjustment) <= 5000), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
